market_view: Calm regime: VIX 16.5 and falling, a soft US inflation reading lifted stocks, but Warsh signalled 'no tolerance' for high inflation and the 10-year yield stays near its high at 4.59%. The Middle East (US-Iran, Hormuz) remains the main commodity risk.

oil_gas.catalyst: 'Oil prices rise 2% to one-month high as US-Iran attacks deepen supply disruption' (Reuters, 2026-07-14); no de-escalation headline yet
oil_gas.reasoning: Holding the XOM long from 2026-07-07. WTI +12.6% over 5 days to 79.34 while XOM is only +2.4%, so the supply shock is not fully reflected in the stock. Exit on a de-escalation headline; earnings season adds variance.

gold_miners.reasoning: NEM headlines are opinion pieces ('slides 16%', 'cheap blue chip'). Soft CPI helped gold +1.6%, but Warsh is hawkish and real rates and the dollar are still headwinds. No named catalyst.

chips.reasoning: NVIDIA robotics and Japan product announcements are routine releases; the valuation piece is opinion; Micron's US commitment is not about NVDA. NVDA is already up 7.6% over 5 days. No checkable catalyst.

pharma.reasoning: No trial, approval or pricing headline for LLY; the sector fell 3.7% over 5 days without a named cause. Flat.

copper_uranium.reasoning: No copper-specific catalyst for FCX; its +3.3% day follows copper +1.6% and is priced in. 'Cameco Resolves Cigar Lake Disruption' (Yahoo Finance) concerns CCJ and eases uranium supply, which is not a positive for the leader.

would_change_my_mind: A US-Iran ceasefire or Hormuz reopening headline (exit XOM); a named NEM, NVDA, LLY or FCX catalyst such as guidance, approval or export-rule change.

handoff.what_changed: Oil re-escalated: WTI +12.6% over 5 days to 79.34 (Brent 84.73), Reuters reports US-Iran attacks deepening supply disruption; XOM lagged at +2.4%. A soft US CPI reading lifted stocks and gold (+1.6%), but Warsh told Congress the Fed has 'no tolerance' for high inflation. Cameco resolved the Cigar Lake disruption.

oil_gas.why: The Hormuz/US-Iran supply shock is escalating with no de-escalation headline; confidence 0.53.

gold_miners.why: Only opinion pieces on NEM; hawkish Fed chair and high real rates remain headwinds.

chips.why: NVIDIA headlines are routine product news; no checkable catalyst.

pharma.why: No trial, approval or pricing news for LLY.

copper_uranium.why: No copper catalyst for FCX; Cigar Lake resolution concerns CCJ and eases uranium supply.

open_storylines.name: Hormuz / Iran escalation
open_storylines.note: US-Iran attacks deepened supply disruption on July 14; oil at a one-month high. A ceasefire or reopening headline means exiting XOM.

open_storylines.name: Oil price slide vs shock
open_storylines.note: WTI 79.34, still -16% over 60 days and US output at a record; the shock bounce could fade fast.

open_storylines.name: Gold bear market and Fed
open_storylines.note: Gold 23.5% below its high; soft CPI vs Warsh 'no tolerance' stance. Watch for a dovish turn or safe-haven bid.

open_storylines.name: Uranium supply and policy
open_storylines.note: Cigar Lake disruption resolved per Cameco; Australia-India export deal. Matters for CCJ only if it becomes leader.

open_storylines.name: Q2 earnings season
open_storylines.note: Exxon signalled a Q2 windfall; NEM Q2 call scheduled. Watch for guidance changes; variance, not direction.

handoff.next_job: On the next decision day, check the XOM long (10-day horizon from 2026-07-07, ends around 2026-07-21) against US-Iran and Hormuz news and exit on a de-escalation headline; then read the new record for a named catalyst in each family and decide long or flat.
